literal: Ban Gu said that "the Confucian school arose from the Minister of Education's office, aiding the ruler in harmonizing yin and yang and carrying out transformation."
idiomatic: Ban Gu said that "the Confucian school arose from the Minister of Education's office, aiding the ruler in harmonizing yin and yang and carrying out transformation."

literal: The sage therefore illuminates Heaven's Way and rectifies human relations—thus the ancient sage-kings all followed this path.
idiomatic: The sage therefore illuminates Heaven's Way and rectifies human relations—thus the ancient sage-kings all followed this path.

literal: Gao Huan was born on the frontier marches and grew up amid war-horses; because of the remnant disorders after the Northern Wei collapse, when Erzhu Rong's cruel measures fell upon the age, literature was swept away, rites and music fled together, the sound of string and song was nearly cut off, and the bearing of sacrificial vessels was almost exhausted.
idiomatic: Gao Huan was born on the frontier marches and grew up amid war-horses. After the Northern Wei fell into disorder and Erzhu Rong's cruel measures seized the age, literature was swept away and rites and music fled together; the sound of string and song was nearly cut off, and the bearing of sacrificial vessels was almost gone.

literal: When he raised the banner of righteousness and swept the districts clean, he rectified ruler and subject and aligned superior and inferior.
idiomatic: When he raised the banner of righteousness and swept the districts clean, he rectified ruler and subject and aligned superior and inferior.

literal: When the One Man was cast adrift and the Nine Cauldrons shifted in secret, the vessels of civil and martial power—all turned their gaze here—yet he still supported a collateral branch of the house and again settled the altars of state. Was this not treading ground within the teaching of names, gradually entering the wind of humaneness and righteousness?
idiomatic: When the One Man was cast adrift and the Nine Cauldrons shifted in secret, the vessels of civil and martial power—all turned their gaze here—yet he still supported a collateral branch of the house and again settled the altars of state. Was this not treading ground within the teaching of names, gradually entering the wind of humaneness and righteousness?

literal: Because the borders had many alarms and war-chariots went forth year by year, though the system of schools had not yet been attended to, the way of classical elegance took sudden shape in his heart and thought.
idiomatic: Because the borders had many alarms and war-chariots went forth year by year, though the system of schools had not yet been attended to, the way of classical elegance took sudden shape in his heart and thought.

literal: In the Northern Wei Tianping era, Fanyang Lu Jingyu together with his elder cousin's son Li raised rebellion in their native commandery; Gao Huan pardoned their crimes and placed them in the guest lodge, using the classics to instruct the Prince of Taiyuan and those below him.
idiomatic: In the Northern Wei Tianping era, Fanyang Lu Jingyu together with his elder cousin's son Li raised rebellion in their native commandery. Gao Huan pardoned their crimes and placed them in the guest lodge, using the classics to instruct the Prince of Taiyuan and those below him.

literal: When Jingyu died, Zhao commandery Li Tonggui succeeded him.
idiomatic: When Jingyu died, Zhao commandery Li Tonggui succeeded him.

literal: Both worthies received great favor and were treated with exceptional courtesy.
idiomatic: Both worthies received great favor and were treated with exceptional courtesy.

literal: When Tonggui died, Zhongshan Zhang Diao, Bohai Li Xuan, Diao Rou, Zhongshan Shi Yao, and others were summoned in turn to serve as teachers and friends to the princes.
idiomatic: When Tonggui died, Zhongshan Zhang Diao, Bohai Li Xuan, Diao Rou, Zhongshan Shi Yao, and others were summoned in turn to serve as teachers and friends to the princes.

literal: In the Tianbao, Daning, and Wuping reigns as well, famous Confucians were brought in to teach the classics to the crown prince and the princes.
idiomatic: In the Tianbao, Daning, and Wuping reigns as well, famous Confucians were brought in to teach the classics to the crown prince and the princes.

literal: Yet from the founding down to the final age, only Gao Yan of Jinan while in the Eastern Palace was clever and keen by nature and quite polished himself, thereby completing his excellence.
idiomatic: Yet from the founding down to the final age, only Gao Yan of Jinan while in the Eastern Palace was clever and keen by nature and quite polished himself, thereby completing his excellence.

literal: The rest were mostly arrogant, willful, and fierce; day by day they moved against ritual measure, and month by month there was nothing to be heard of improvement.
idiomatic: The rest were mostly arrogant, willful, and fierce; day by day they moved against ritual measure, and month by month there was nothing to be heard of improvement.

literal: Carving ice and sculpting rotten wood, in the end nothing was achieved—there was reason for it.
idiomatic: Carving ice and sculpting rotten wood, in the end nothing was achieved—there was reason for it.

literal: The emperor's sons and the king's grandsons are endowed with dissolute natures; moreover, when the force of moral instruction is not deep and paths of depravity compete to open, unless one is born with innate knowledge and one's person embraces supreme wisdom, while within there is the pleasure of sound and color and without there is fondness for dogs and horses—how can one enter and practice steadfast conduct, or go out and befriend the worthy?
idiomatic: The emperor's sons and the king's grandsons are endowed with dissolute natures. When the force of moral instruction is not deep and paths of depravity compete to open, unless one is born with innate knowledge and one's person embraces supreme wisdom, while within there is the pleasure of sound and color and without there is fondness for dogs and horses—how can one enter and practice steadfast conduct, or go out and befriend the worthy?

literal: They had only the qualifications of teachers and tutors, yet in the end no reality of polishing.
idiomatic: They had only the qualifications of teachers and tutors, yet in the end no reality of polishing.

literal: Those below followed transformation like wind bending grass—thus among houses of hereditary nobility one rarely heard of strenuous study.
idiomatic: Those below followed transformation like wind bending grass—thus among houses of hereditary nobility one rarely heard of strenuous study.

literal: If the noble wanderers were adorned with mastery of the classics, it could be called bamboo arrows from Ji Hill with feathered shafts added—bowing to pick up purple and crimson rank, one could know it at a glance.
idiomatic: If the noble wanderers were adorned with mastery of the classics, it could be called bamboo arrows from Ji Hill with feathered shafts added—bowing to pick up purple and crimson rank, one could know it at a glance.

literal: Yet Qi offices in charge sometimes lost their posts; mentors, protectors, tutors, and aides were all rewarded for old merit, and doctorate lecturers in the National University had only empty names—only the single National University school had several tens of students. To seek upright officials and a well-governed state, was that possible?
idiomatic: Yet Qi offices in charge sometimes lost their posts; mentors, protectors, tutors, and aides were all rewarded for old merit, and doctorate lecturers in the National University had only empty names—only the single National University school had several tens of students. To seek upright officials and a well-governed state, was that possible?

literal: Among scions who entered office through mastery of the classics there were only Boling Cui Zifa and Guangping Song Youqing; beyond them no such men were seen.
idiomatic: Among scions who entered office through mastery of the classics there were only Boling Cui Zifa and Guangping Song Youqing; beyond them no such men were seen.

literal: Fortunately court regulations were broad and simple and the governmental net sparse and loose; idlers floating in indolence filled nine houses in ten.
idiomatic: Fortunately court regulations were broad and simple and the governmental net sparse and loose; idlers floating in indolence filled nine houses in ten.

literal: Therefore companions who spread the classics and received instruction were everywhere in town and countryside;
idiomatic: Therefore companions who spread the classics and received instruction were everywhere in town and countryside;

literal: those who bore satchels and followed office did not shrink from a thousand li.
idiomatic: those who bore satchels and followed office did not shrink from a thousand li.

literal: They embraced learning without slackening and guided others tirelessly.
idiomatic: They embraced learning without slackening and guided others tirelessly.

literal: Entering within hamlets and lanes, they took begging for food as their support;
idiomatic: Entering within hamlets and lanes, they took begging for food as their support;

literal: resting in the shade of their native mulberry trees, they moved in numbers exceeding a thousand.
idiomatic: resting in the shade of their native mulberry trees, they moved in numbers exceeding a thousand.

literal: Among the customs of Yan and Zhao, this crowd was especially numerous.
idiomatic: Among the customs of Yan and Zhao, this crowd was especially numerous.

literal: Qi regulations: every commandery established a school, set doctorate assistants to teach the classics, and students were all forcibly pressed to fill quotas; the scholar-gentry and powerful rich households all refused assignment.
idiomatic: Qi regulations: every commandery established a school, set doctorate assistants to teach the classics, and students were all forcibly pressed to fill quotas; the scholar-gentry and powerful rich households all refused assignment.

literal: Since filling quotas was not what they desired, tomb texts and records naturally did not concern them; moreover many were driven by commandery and prefecture officials—though there were idlers, no inspection was made. All stemmed from what those above did not favor.
idiomatic: Since filling quotas was not what they desired, tomb texts and records naturally did not concern them; moreover many were driven by commandery and prefecture officials—though there were idlers, no inspection was made. All stemmed from what those above did not favor.

literal: Every commandery could recommend Filial and Incorrupt candidates; among doctorate assistants, teaching assistants, and wandering students who had mastered the classics, the outstanding were chosen to fill the quota.
idiomatic: Every commandery could recommend Filial and Incorrupt candidates; among doctorate assistants, teaching assistants, and wandering students who had mastered the classics, the outstanding were chosen to fill the quota.

literal: In the target-shooting examination of ten questions, those who passed eight or more were permitted entry at the ninth rank; the especially outstanding also received special promotion.
idiomatic: In the target-shooting examination of ten questions, those who passed eight or more were permitted entry at the ninth rank; the especially outstanding also received special promotion.

literal: Generally, students of classical learning mostly came from the school of Xu Zunming, the great Confucian of late Wei.
idiomatic: Generally, students of classical learning mostly came from the school of Xu Zunming, the great Confucian of late Wei.

literal: North of the Yellow River they lectured on Zheng Xuan's commentary to the Book of Changes.
idiomatic: North of the Yellow River they lectured on Zheng Xuan's commentary to the Book of Changes.

literal: Zunming transmitted to Lu Jingyu of Qinghe and Cui Jin; Jingyu transmitted to Quan Hui; Hui transmitted to Guo Mao.
idiomatic: Zunming transmitted to Lu Jingyu of Qinghe and Cui Jin; Jingyu transmitted to Quan Hui; Hui transmitted to Guo Mao.

literal: Hui entered the capital early; Guo Mao constantly taught at the gate.
idiomatic: Hui entered the capital early; Guo Mao constantly taught at the gate.

literal: Afterward those who could discourse on the Book of Changes mostly came from Guo Mao's school.
idiomatic: Afterward those who could discourse on the Book of Changes mostly came from Guo Mao's school.

literal: South of the Yellow River and in Qing and Qi, Confucian students mostly lectured on Wang Fusi's commentary to the Book of Changes; teacherly instruction was quite sparse.
idiomatic: South of the Yellow River and in Qing and Qi, Confucian students mostly lectured on Wang Fusi's commentary to the Book of Changes; teacherly instruction was quite sparse.

literal: Among Qi Confucians, few transmitted the study of the Book of Documents; Xu Zunming mastered it as well.
idiomatic: Among Qi Confucians, few transmitted the study of the Book of Documents; Xu Zunming mastered it as well.

literal: Zunming received instruction from Tunliu Wang Zong and transmitted to Fuyang Li Zhouren, Bohai Zhang Wenjing, Li Xuan, and Quan Hui—all Zheng Xuan's commentary, not the ancient text version.
idiomatic: Zunming received instruction from Tunliu Wang Zong and transmitted to Fuyang Li Zhouren, Bohai Zhang Wenjing, Li Xuan, and Quan Hui—all Zheng Xuan's commentary, not the ancient text version.

literal: Students in the lower countryside scarcely saw Kong Anguo's commentary.
idiomatic: Students in the lower countryside scarcely saw Kong Anguo's commentary.

literal: At the end of Wuping, Hejian Liu Guangbo and Xindu Liu Shiyuan first obtained Fei Kan's Expository Commentary and then gave it attention.
idiomatic: At the end of Wuping, Hejian Liu Guangbo and Xindu Liu Shiyuan first obtained Fei Kan's Expository Commentary and then gave it attention.

literal: The Book of Odes, the Rites, and the Spring and Autumn Annals were especially honored in the age; most students mastered more than one.
idiomatic: The Book of Odes, the Rites, and the Spring and Autumn Annals were especially honored in the age; most students mastered more than one.

literal: The Three Rites all came from Zunming's school.
idiomatic: The Three Rites all came from Zunming's school.

literal: Xu transmitted the profession to Li Xuan, Ju Jun, Tian Yuanfeng, Feng Wei, Ji Xianjing, Lü Huanglong, and Xia Huaijing.
idiomatic: Xu transmitted the profession to Li Xuan, Ju Jun, Tian Yuanfeng, Feng Wei, Ji Xianjing, Lü Huanglong, and Xia Huaijing.

literal: Li Xuan again transmitted to Diao Rou, Zhang Mainu, Bao Jixiang, Xing Zhi, Liu Zhou, and Xiong Ansheng.
idiomatic: Li Xuan again transmitted to Diao Rou, Zhang Mainu, Bao Jixiang, Xing Zhi, Liu Zhou, and Xiong Ansheng.

literal: Ansheng again transmitted to Sun Linghui, Guo Zhongjian, and Ding Side.
idiomatic: Ansheng again transmitted to Sun Linghui, Guo Zhongjian, and Ding Side.

literal: Afterward students who could master the Classic of Rites were mostly Ansheng's disciples.
idiomatic: Afterward students who could master the Classic of Rites were mostly Ansheng's disciples.

literal: Students all mastered the Elder Dai Rites; those who also mastered the Rites of Zhou and the Etiquette and Ritual were only one or two in ten.
idiomatic: Students all mastered the Elder Dai Rites; those who also mastered the Rites of Zhou and the Etiquette and Ritual were only one or two in ten.

literal: Those who mastered the Mao version of the Book of Odes mostly came from Liu Xianzhi of Boling in the Wei court.
idiomatic: Those who mastered the Mao version of the Book of Odes mostly came from Liu Xianzhi of Boling in the Wei court.

literal: Xianzhi transmitted to Li Zhouren; Zhouren transmitted to Dong Lingdu and Cheng Guize; Guize transmitted to Liu Jinghe, Zhang Sibo, and Liu Guisi.
idiomatic: Xianzhi transmitted to Li Zhouren; Zhouren transmitted to Dong Lingdu and Cheng Guize; Guize transmitted to Liu Jinghe, Zhang Sibo, and Liu Guisi.

literal: Afterward those who could discourse on the Book of Odes mostly came from the two Liu's schools.
idiomatic: Afterward those who could discourse on the Book of Odes mostly came from the two Liu's schools.

literal: North of the Yellow River Confucians who mastered the Spring and Autumn Annals all followed Fu Qian's commentary and likewise came from Xu's disciples.
idiomatic: North of the Yellow River Confucians who mastered the Spring and Autumn Annals all followed Fu Qian's commentary and likewise came from Xu's disciples.

literal: Zhang Mainu, Ma Jingde, Xing Zhi, Zhang Sibo, Zhang Diao, Liu Zhou, Bao Changxuan, and Wang Yuanze all obtained the subtlety of Fu's school.
idiomatic: Zhang Mainu, Ma Jingde, Xing Zhi, Zhang Sibo, Zhang Diao, Liu Zhou, Bao Changxuan, and Wang Yuanze all obtained the subtlety of Fu's school.

literal: There were also Wei Kan, Chen Da, and Pan Shudu who, though they did not transmit Xu Zunming's school, were thoroughly versed.
idiomatic: There were also Wei Kan, Chen Da, and Pan Shudu who, though they did not transmit Xu Zunming's school, were thoroughly versed.

literal: There were also Yao Wen'an and Qin Daojing who at first studied Fu's school and later also lectured on Du Yu's commentary.
idiomatic: There were also Yao Wen'an and Qin Daojing who at first studied Fu's school and later also lectured on Du Yu's commentary.

literal: Confucian students beyond the river all revered Du's school.
idiomatic: Confucian students beyond the river all revered Du's school.

literal: The Gongyang and Guliang traditions—most Confucians paid them no heed.
idiomatic: The Gongyang and Guliang traditions—most Confucians paid them no heed.

literal: The Analects and the Classic of Filial Piety—all students lectured on them without exception.
idiomatic: The Analects and the Classic of Filial Piety—all students lectured on them without exception.

literal: Confucians such as Quan Hui, Li Xuan, Diao Rou, Xiong Ansheng, Liu Guisi, Ma Jingde, and the like mostly produced their own expository commentaries.
idiomatic: Confucians such as Quan Hui, Li Xuan, Diao Rou, Xiong Ansheng, Liu Guisi, Ma Jingde, and the like mostly produced their own expository commentaries.

literal: Though called specialists, all were only roughly practiced.
idiomatic: Though called specialists, all were only roughly practiced.

literal: Now in the sequence recorded, some students ended in the Wei court or attained no fame in office; even if they could make a name for their school, their origins and native commanderies are missing—only their names are briefly preserved.
idiomatic: Now in the sequence recorded, some students ended in the Wei court or attained no fame in office; even if they could make a name for their school, their origins and native commanderies are missing—only their names are briefly preserved.

literal: All take the most thoroughly versed and illustrious and list them in Confucian Scholars.
idiomatic: All take the most thoroughly versed and illustrious and list them in Confucian Scholars.

literal: Xiong Ansheng's name appears in Zhou history; Guangbo and Shiyuan are set forth in the History of Sui—here they are not repeated.
idiomatic: Xiong Ansheng's name appears in Zhou history; Guangbo and Shiyuan are set forth in the History of Sui—here they are not repeated.

literal: Li Xuan, styled Baoding, was a man of Nanpi in Bohai.
idiomatic: Li Xuan, styled Baoding, came from Nanpi in Bohai.

literal: At nine he entered school and copied the Rapid Writing Primer; in little more than a month he had mastered it.
idiomatic: At nine he entered school and copied the Rapid Writing Primer; in little more than a month he had mastered it.

literal: His family had long been poor; in spring and summer he always worked the fields, and only in winter entered school.
idiomatic: His family had long been poor; in spring and summer he always worked the fields, and only in winter entered school.

literal: At sixteen he received the Mao version of the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents from Fuyang Li Zhouren, the Record of Rites from Zhangwu Liu Zimeng, the Rites of Zhou and the Etiquette and Ritual from Changshan Fang Qiu, and the Zuo Tradition to the Spring and Autumn Annals from Yuyang Xianyu Lingfu.
idiomatic: At sixteen he received the Mao version of the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents from Fuyang Li Zhouren, the Record of Rites from Zhangwu Liu Zimeng, the Rites of Zhou and the Etiquette and Ritual from Changshan Fang Qiu, and the Zuo Tradition to the Spring and Autumn Annals from Yuyang Xianyu Lingfu.

literal: Because there was no teacher in his district, he joined Yang Yuanyi of the province and Zong Huizhen of Hejian and others as companions to go to the great Confucian Xu Zunming to receive instruction.
idiomatic: Because there was no teacher in his district, he joined Yang Yuanyi of the province and Zong Huizhen of Hejian and others as companions to go to the great Confucian Xu Zunming to receive instruction.

literal: He dwelt five years at Xu's gate and was constantly called a top student.
idiomatic: He dwelt five years at Xu's gate and was constantly called a top student.

literal: At twenty-three he withdrew to seclusion, discussed right and wrong, and compiled expository commentaries on the Classic of Filial Piety, the Analects, the Mao version of the Book of Odes, and the Three Rites, together with Divergences among the Three Traditions, and Patterns in the Meaning of the Book of Changes—in all more than thirty juan.
idiomatic: At twenty-three he withdrew to seclusion, discussed right and wrong, and compiled expository commentaries on the Classic of Filial Piety, the Analects, the Mao version of the Book of Odes, and the Three Rites, together with Divergences among the Three Traditions and Patterns in the Meaning of the Book of Changes—in all more than thirty juan.

literal: His mind was refined and bitterly strained; three winters he kept no pillow, and whenever sleep came he only dozed.
idiomatic: His mind was refined and bitterly strained; three winters he kept no pillow, and whenever sleep came he only dozed.

literal: At twenty-seven he returned to nourish both parents and thereby taught in his district; students constantly reached several hundred.
idiomatic: At twenty-seven he returned to nourish both parents and thereby taught in his district; students constantly reached several hundred.

literal: Among Yan and Zhao, those who could discourse on the classics mostly came from his school.
idiomatic: Among Yan and Zhao, those who could discourse on the classics mostly came from his school.

literal: At thirty-six he mourned his father's death.
idiomatic: At thirty-six he mourned his father's death.

literal: When mourning ended, because his district had few texts, he came to wander the capital and read books he had not yet seen.
idiomatic: When mourning ended, because his district had few texts, he came to wander the capital and read books he had not yet seen.

literal: The province recommended him as Filial and Incorrupt; he was appointed doctorate lecturer in the Imperial University.
idiomatic: The province recommended him as Filial and Incorrupt; he was appointed doctorate lecturer in the Imperial University.

literal: In the Wuding era, after Li Tonggui died, Gao Huan ordered Gao Cheng in the capital finely to select great scholars to teach the princes.
idiomatic: In the Wuding era, after Li Tonggui died, Gao Huan ordered Gao Cheng in the capital finely to select great scholars to teach the princes.

literal: Gao Cheng, because Xuan answered the intent, summoned him to Jinyang.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng, because Xuan answered the intent, summoned him to Jinyang.

literal: At the time Zhongshan Shi Yao, Beiping Yang Xuan, Beihai Wang Xi, Qinghe Cui Zhan, Guangping Song Qindao, and the skilled calligrapher Han Yi were together in the Eastern Lodge, teachers and friends to the princes.
idiomatic: At the time Zhongshan Shi Yao, Beiping Yang Xuan, Beihai Wang Xi, Qinghe Cui Zhan, Guangping Song Qindao, and the skilled calligrapher Han Yi were together in the Eastern Lodge, teachers and friends to the princes.

literal: Xuan, because the sage had been distant for long and written characters had many errors, moved by Confucius's words "one must correct names," sighed with the intent to edit and correct.
idiomatic: Xuan, because the sage had been distant for long and written characters had many errors, moved by Confucius's words "one must correct names," sighed with the intent to edit and correct.

literal: In the intervals of lecturing he perused Explaining Graphs and Analyzing Characters, and also the Cang Jie and Erya, deleting and correcting mistaken characters in the annotated texts of the Six Classics, titled Character Discrimination.
idiomatic: In the intervals of lecturing he perused Explaining Graphs and Analyzing Characters, and also the Cang Jie and Erya, deleting and correcting mistaken characters in the annotated texts of the Six Classics, titled Character Discrimination.

literal: When Gao Yang received the mandate he followed the imperial procession back to the capital.
idiomatic: When Gao Yang received the mandate he followed the imperial procession back to the capital.

literal: Early in Tianbao an edict ordered Xuan together with palace director Xing Shao, palace secretary Wei Shou, and others to deliberate on rites and statutes; he was concurrently doctorate lecturer in the National University.
idiomatic: Early in Tianbao an edict ordered Xuan together with palace director Xing Shao, palace secretary Wei Shou, and others to deliberate on rites and statutes; he was concurrently doctorate lecturer in the National University.

literal: At the time an edict ordered Beiping administrator Song Jingye, Xihe administrator Qimu Huaiwen, and others to draft the new calendar; Recorder of the Masters of Writing Pingyuan Wang Gaolongzhi ordered Xuan together with direct-communication attendant Fang Yanyou and National University doctorate Diao Rou to examine gains and losses.
idiomatic: At the time an edict ordered Beiping administrator Song Jingye, Xihe administrator Qimu Huaiwen, and others to draft the new calendar; Recorder of the Masters of Writing Pingyuan Wang Gaolongzhi ordered Xuan together with direct-communication attendant Fang Yanyou and National University doctorate Diao Rou to examine gains and losses.

literal: Soon he was made regular doctorate lecturer in the National University.
idiomatic: Soon he was made regular doctorate lecturer in the National University.

literal: When the Later Sovereign was in the Eastern Palace, Gao Yang edicted Xuan to enter and teach the classics; he received very generous courtesy.
idiomatic: When the Later Sovereign was in the Eastern Palace, Gao Yang edicted Xuan to enter and teach the classics; he received very generous courtesy.

literal: Several years later he died of illness.
idiomatic: Several years later he died of illness.

literal: He was specially posthumously enfeoffed as vice director of the court of justice.
idiomatic: He was specially posthumously enfeoffed as vice director of the court of justice.

literal: When he was returned for burial in his native commandery, the crown prince sent rites of condolence and sacrifice, and also dispatched a royal envoy to escort the coffin—Confucians counted it an honor.
idiomatic: When he was returned for burial in his native commandery, the crown prince sent rites of condolence and sacrifice, and also dispatched a royal envoy to escort the coffin—Confucians counted it an honor.

literal: Yang Yuanyi and Zong Huizhen also both reached the post of National University doctorate lecturer.
idiomatic: Yang Yuanyi and Zong Huizhen also both reached the post of National University doctorate lecturer.

literal: Diao Rou, styled Ziwen, was a man of Bohai.
idiomatic: Diao Rou, styled Ziwen, came from Bohai.

literal: His father Zheng was Northern Wei general of swift cavalry and posthumously enfeoffed as minister of works.
idiomatic: His father Zheng was Northern Wei general of swift cavalry and posthumously enfeoffed as minister of works.

literal: Rou from youth loved learning, ranged through the classics and histories, and especially attended to ritual and etiquette.
idiomatic: Rou from youth loved learning, ranged through the classics and histories, and especially attended to ritual and etiquette.

literal: His nature was strongly retentive; regarding clans within and without, he was well acquainted with many.
idiomatic: His nature was strongly retentive; regarding clans within and without, he was well acquainted with many.

literal: At first he was a mourning attendant for Gao Cheng; he entered office as acting staff member in the ministry of works.
idiomatic: At first he was a mourning attendant for Gao Cheng; he entered office as acting staff member in the ministry of works.

literal: When his mother died, he completed mourning and was known for filial piety.
idiomatic: When his mother died, he completed mourning and was known for filial piety.

literal: In the Yong'an era he was made steadfast general and chariot commandant, with added rank as champion general and palace gentleman for attendance.
idiomatic: In the Yong'an era he was made steadfast general and chariot commandant, with added rank as champion general and palace gentleman for attendance.

literal: In the Yuanxiang era he followed precedent to Jinyang; Gao Huan made him long-flowing staff member in Prince of Yong'an's establishment office and again ordered him to teach the princes.
idiomatic: In the Yuanxiang era he followed precedent to Jinyang; Gao Huan made him long-flowing staff member in Prince of Yong'an's establishment office and again ordered him to teach the princes.

literal: Early in Tianbao he was made National University doctorate lecturer and palace secretary.
idiomatic: Early in Tianbao he was made National University doctorate lecturer and palace secretary.

literal: Wei Shou compiled the History of Wei and memorialized that Rou and others should share in the task.
idiomatic: Wei Shou compiled the History of Wei and memorialized that Rou and others should share in the task.
